title: 第15章 炼气九层第16章 圣女大人的疑惑
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
顾平踏入大殿时，箫千凝正背对着他站在暖玉床前。
素白中衣被夜风吹得紧贴腰线，露出蝴蝶骨凌厉的轮廓。
她转身时，顾平发现她眼底猩红未褪——显然煞气又发作了。
顾平走近了两步，准备找机会治疗一下她身上的煞气。
“你要去送死？”
箫千凝指尖挑起他下巴，绝色俏脸紧贴着顾平的脸，黑紫色煞气顺着她的指尖缠绕上顾平脖颈，“炼气八层就敢接剿灭血衣盟的任务？“
顾平默默运转双修功法。
当箫千凝的煞气触碰到他皮肤时，竟化作暖流涌入经脉。
他闷哼一声，修为竟隐隐松动。
箫千凝突然贴近，鼻尖抵住他皱纹横生的脸颊，“那么，你是来讨要保命手段的？”
苍老的手突然抓住她手腕。
顾平体内迸发的阳气让殿内温度骤升：“弟子是来...帮首座大人的，即将外出，首座大人的身体，弟子实在是放心不过。”
阴阳圣体早就已经觉醒，箫千凝被拽倒在寒玉床上。
她惊觉这老家伙力气竟然变大了这么多。
仔细分辨发现，他的炼体修为竟已接近凡胎境。
“你！”
元婴威压刚要爆发，顾平却将额头抵在她腰间。
蓬勃阳气透过丹田涌入，那些纠缠她百年的阴煞和上次一样，迅速消失。
箫千凝停了下来，没有再反抗。
“你不怕我一巴掌拍死你吗？”

她声音很冷。
“首座说过...”
顾平粗糙的掌心抚过她腿侧，“我是九幽峰的人，那弟子就要多多关照首座大人的身体，远行之际实在不忍首座遭受阴煞之苦。”
“大胆老奴，放肆！”
她觉得顾平的手太胆大了。
只能双手撑着，不让顾平的身体压下来，眼中的红光丝毫没少。
顾平没法，只能起身。
他可不敢太冒犯。
元婴女修士杀他只需要轻轻一口气。
但是，起身之后，箫千凝却依旧躺在温玉床上。
这让他心思婉转。
顾平转而跪坐在床边，伸出手抓住了箫千凝的脚。
脱掉鞋子和罗袜。
粗糙的指节正捏着箫千凝的脚踝。
女子足尖绷直，煞气凝成的冰霜顺着小腿蔓延，却在触碰到顾平掌心的瞬间化作暖流。
“首座大人的阴煞……比半月前重了许多。
他拇指摩挲着她凸起的踝骨，阴阳二气在接触处流转。
箫千凝忽然屈膝，白玉纤足抵住他下巴，“不知死活的老东西！”
content_en:
When Gu Ping stepped into the main hall, Xiao Qianning was standing in front of the warm jade bed with her back to him.
The plain white middle coat was blown close to the waistline by the night wind, revealing the sharp outline of the butterfly bones.
When she turned around, Gu Ping found that the scarlet red in her eyes had not faded—it was obvious that the evil spirit had struck again.
Gu Ping took two steps closer, ready to find a chance to cure the evil spirit on her body.
"Are you going to die?"
Xiao Qianning lifted his chin with her fingertips, her beautiful face pressed against Gu Ping's face, and the black and purple evil energy wrapped around Gu Ping's neck along her fingertips, "You dare to accept the task of wiping out the Blood Clothes Alliance at the eighth level of Qi refining?"
Gu Ping silently operated the dual cultivation technique.
When Xiao Qianning's evil spirit touched his skin, it turned into warm current and poured into his meridians.
He groaned, and his cultivation became faintly loose.
Xiao Qianning suddenly came close to him, her nose touching his wrinkled cheek, "So, you're here to ask for a way to save your life?"
The old hand suddenly grabbed her wrist.
The yang energy bursting out of Gu Ping's body caused the temperature in the hall to rise sharply: "This disciple is here... to help the First Master. He is about to go out. The First Master's body is not something I can worry about."
The Yin-Yang Holy Body had already awakened, and Xiao Qianning was dragged down on the cold jade bed.
She was shocked to find that this old guy had become so much stronger.
After careful analysis, it was discovered that his body-refining cultivation was close to the mortal realm.
"You!"
Just as Nascent Soul's pressure was about to explode, Gu Ping pressed his forehead against her waist.
Vigorous yang energy poured in through her Dantian, and the evil spirits that had entangled her for hundreds of years disappeared quickly like last time.
Xiao Qianning stopped and did not resist again.
"Aren't you afraid that I'll slap you to death?"
Her voice was cold.
"The leader said..."
Gu Ping's rough palm caressed the side of her leg, "I am from Jiuyou Peak, so this disciple should take more care of the body of the first lady. I really can't bear the suffering of the evil spirits in the first seat when traveling far away."
"Bold old slave, let's be bold!"
She felt that Gu Ping's hands were too bold.
He could only hold on with his hands to prevent Gu Ping's body from pressing down, and the red light in his eyes did not diminish at all.
Gu Ping had no choice but to get up.
He didn't dare to be too offended.
The Nascent Soul female monk only needed a gentle breath to kill him.
However, after getting up, Xiao Qianning was still lying on Wen Yu's bed.
This made him change his mind.
Gu Ping turned and knelt down beside the bed, stretched out his hand and grabbed Xiao Qianning's feet.
Take off your shoes and socks.
Rough knuckles were pinching Xiao Qianning's ankle.
The woman's toes were straightened, and the frost formed by evil spirits spread along her calves, but turned into warmth the moment it touched Gu Ping's palm.
"The Yin evil spirit of the First Lord...is much heavier than half a month ago.
His thumb rubbed her raised ankle bone, and the yin and yang energy flowed at the contact point.
Xiao Qianning suddenly bent her knees, and her delicate white jade feet pressed against his chin, "You old man who doesn't know how to live or die! "
